# NULL propagation from GoogleSQL compliance testdata/strings.test (split_nulls).
# Read inputs from rows to exercise the backend rather than constant folding.
SELECT SPLIT(value) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) AS value
=> "true"

SELECT SPLIT(value, ',') IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) AS value
=> "true"

SELECT SPLIT('x', delimiter) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) AS delimiter
=> "true"

SELECT SPLIT(CAST(NULL AS STRING), delimiter) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) AS delimiter
=> "true"

SELECT SPLIT(b'x', delimiter) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS BYTES)]) AS delimiter
=> "true"
